This data set contains eight (8) registered scans of the archaeological remains at Cochrane Ranche. The excavation was performed by Bison Historical Services prior to the intersection between Hwy 1A and Hwy 22 was modified by Alberta Transport. The data was collected by the Capture 2 Preserve Team with a Z+F 5010X laser scanner on November 5, 2020. The data was processed and cleaned in Z+F Laser Control V. 9.2.1.
